format: freestanding Dunkin' restaurant (Table A); shopping center/storefront, gas & convenience and non-traditional (SDO) formats also offered

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a freestanding Dunkin' restaurant ranges from $532,400 to $1,832,500.  This includes a range of $40,340 to $112,740 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: Standard Dunkin' Restaurant $40,000 to $90,000 depending on the Development Area Type (described below)
fee.note: IFF set by DMA: Type 1 $90,000, Type 2 $80,000, Type 3 $70,000, Type 4 $60,000, Type 5 $50,000, Type 6 $40,000. Gas station/convenience store IFF pro-rated by term; self-service and SDO IFF is 50% of standard. During fiscal 2025 the IFF paid ranged from $0 to $90,000. Initial Training Fee for first 2 people included in IFF. The Center Initial Access Fee $340 at signing. VetFran: CFF credit of $10,000 per restaurant, up to $100,000.

royalty.quote: Continuing Franchise Fee ("CFF") 5.9% of Gross Sales (Note 1) On or before Thursday of each week, for the seven-day sales reporting period ending at the close of business on Saturday, twelve days previous

adFund.quote: Continuing Advertising Fee ("CAF") 5.0% of Gross Sales 2.5% of Gross Sales for SDOs Weekly with the CFF (Note 3)
adFund.note: Standard incentive: CAF 2% through Year 1, 3% Year 2, 4% Year 3, 5% Year 4 onward; Strategic incentive: 2.4% through Year 5, 3.4% Years 6-8, 5.0% Year 9 onward. Also a mandatory opening Marketing Start-Up spend of at least $10,000.

otherRecurring.name: Loyalty Program Contribution Payment
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, 1.4% of Loyalty Program Sales, weekly with the CFF (1.2% from 2027)

otherRecurring.name: POS System and BOH Technical Maintenance (approved vendor)
otherRecurring.amount: Fixed monthly fees range from $10 to $25 per Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: Advance and Remote Ordering (approved vendor)
otherRecurring.amount: fixed monthly fees ranging from $0 to $75 as well as transaction fees ranging from 2.0% to 15.0% of the order amount

rentToFranchisor: Only if you lease from an affiliate: "you will pay our affiliates a monthly the fixed rent set forth in your lease. You may also pay us percentage rent regardless of whether the prime lease requires percentage rent. The amount of percentage rent varies and will be set forth in your lease." No % printed.

Excludes 314 opened in 2025, 1,261 closed for extended periods, 36 Multi-Brand, 111 self-serve, 25 part-time, 81 closed in 2025, company-owned and 1,219 Combo restaurants. Unaudited.

special: Royalty and ad fee incentives (Standard/Strategic/Pacific Northwest programs) give CFF credits of $125,000, $225,000 or up to $300,000 and reduced CAF in early years. Loyalty Program Contribution of 1.4% of Loyalty Program Sales on top of CFF and CAF. If leasing from an affiliate, fixed rent plus possible percentage rent (amount not printed). More than 95% of purchases to establish and operate are under franchisor specifications; affiliates received $132,600,000 from sales/leases to franchisees in 2025. Delivery vehicle not included in Item 7 total. Item 20 counts exclude Combo (Dunkin'/Baskin-Robbins) restaurants.
